title: How to Enjoy the AR Filter: Get Cuter or Funnier 😂✨
content:
Hey creators,

Are you interested in AR filters? Or do you think they've already peaked?  
If that's the case, then pay attention now! 

Create moments that are cuter and more fun than you ever imagined with AR outfits. This AR filter can be worn by anyone, from babies to adults, so experiment with your own style! 🤭💥

Try out styles you can play around with, from trendy clothes to popular meme outfits. Put on the latest fashion or surprise your friends with a laugh-inducing meme outfit! 😎👗

# **👶 Cute Version?**

We tried this AR filter on babies, and it was too cute! The little ones look absolutely adorable in their hip-hop outfits!

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N1uv8y8oQgo?start=0

  


# **🤣 Funny Version?**

But when we applied the filter to an aerobics-dressed guy? A totally different vibe! It turned into a fun vibe that had everyone laughing! 😂 You wouldn’t believe how much one filter can change the vibe!

![2944b2fbb2f44e2788ea8243d137cbdc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/03a603ec73524b37b5176dd069041e16/images/2944b2fbb2f44e2788ea8243d137cbdcapply.png)

  


# **💡 How to Use the AR Filter**

1️⃣ Scan the QR code above. (You can use Snapchat or TikTok apps.)  
2️⃣ When the camera opens, select the filter.  
3️⃣ Try on a virtual outfit on your smartphone screen!  
4️⃣ Take a photo or video and share it on our community page or social media!

# **💡 Tips for Use!**

✔️ Upload your photos or videos to Social Media and share them with your friends!  
✔️ Try different poses to find your unique style!  
✔️ Experiment with cute or funny versions to create different looks!

# **🎨 Want to Create Your Own?**

Would you like to create your own filter? We already have a Snapchat AR filter tutorial ready for you, [so check it out!](https://support-connect.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/9431689555343-Tutorials)

And the best part? We're also working on a **TikTok** tutorial, so stay tuned!🎥🔥 

If you have any questions, feel free to leave a comment! 😊

  


![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202504/03a603ec73524b37b5176dd069041e16/images/7ab643faa62d4c03b05bef017f38e8f9thumb.png)

title: Chocolate & Coffee: A Recipe with Changhun
content:
## _Discover how 3D artist Boo Changhun blends technology and creativity in Chocolate & Coffee, a virtual fashion project inspired by rich flavors and textures, crafted using CLO, Unreal Engine, and MetaHuman._

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yL0JUKybiNU?start=0

* * *

# **Interview with**  
**Boo Changhun | Lecturer & 3D Artist, CONNECT Supporters**

![2b9ec2ff57c3412d9adeb9aa1ddd2694](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/2b9ec2ff57c3412d9adeb9aa1ddd2694profile.webp)

# **How Did Changhun’s Virtual Fashion Journey Begin?**

I'm Boo Changhun, a virtual fashion lecturer and creator with five years of experience. My journey started with graphics in high school, leading to CLO in graduate school. Now, I use CLO, Twinmotion, Unreal Engine, and 3D Vista for 3D modeling.

# **What Inspired the Chocolate & Coffee Project?**

Inspired by **Mocha Mousse** , this year’s color, and my love for mocha lattes, this project captures the **balance of chocolate’s sweetness and coffee’s bitterness** in fashion design. Soft, curved elements like arched windows, ionic pillars, and ruffles reflect **chocolate’s richness** , while **coffee’s rough texture** appears in concrete, leather, and fitted silhouettes, shaping the project’s aesthetic.

![b6e0ce4dd3cc44f6818520ab19447555](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/b6e0ce4dd3cc44f6818520ab194475551.%20Mood%20Board.png)

# **How Did You Approach the Workflow for Your Chocolate & Coffee Project?**

For** _the Chocolate & Coffee project_**, I managed everything—from music to costumes, avatars, and architecture—to fully capture the desired mood. I used Metahuman for the avatar, customizing its motion and refining its face with Daz Studio's Facetransfer2, blending AI-generated images with Daz’s asset ratios for the perfect look.

![4cd5a66a170942eda83e58641b72b2f2](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/4cd5a66a170942eda83e58641b72b2f22.%20Daz%20Studio%20Facetranfer2.jpg)

I imported the avatar into Unreal Engine as an FBX file, adjusting its body size, skeleton, and materials to fit Metahuman. Though tedious, this process streamlines motion creation using Unreal’s ControlRig.

![c989614905a14d22b70f00a0618af4c3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/c989614905a14d22b70f00a0618af4c33.%20Metahuman%20Identity.jpg)![67265025358e4587b3fb543059cba6a7](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/67265025358e4587b3fb543059cba6a74.%20Metahuman.jpg)

I designed the clothes in CLO, blending chocolate’s softness with coffee’s rough texture through shape, color, and material. While CLO supports Metahuman avatars, I adjusted its FV2 avatar to match Metahuman’s size for rendering with AI Avatar Studio.

![82a7d65cdba7498caf1fea037af8cc3f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/82a7d65cdba7498caf1fea037af8cc3f5.%20CLO%20AI%20Avatar%20Studio%20Render.png)

Using the referenced images, CLO was used to create a central space where chocolate flows into Mocha Mousse color, with one side featuring rough concrete and the other showcasing an arch-shaped window and Ionic column.

![652af7f425684185bb4f4acb1156ec87](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/652af7f425684185bb4f4acb1156ec876.%20Building%20Modeling.jpg)![d1d73c819b3b44d48267311c7142f8c2](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/d1d73c819b3b44d48267311c7142f8c27.%20Building%20modeling%202.png)

To visually convey the concept, CLO created objects like chocolate-filled columns, mugs, coffee beans, and leather sofas. These objects, along with the designed spaces, were exported to Unreal Engine in OBJ format and scaled accordingly.

![45fc48d98d8b498d8206ca7999ddac58](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/45fc48d98d8b498d8206ca7999ddac588.%20Object%20Modeling.jpg)

Materials were created using Unreal Engine’s Blueprint function, with concrete textures from Quixel Bridge, and chocolate and coffee textures generated using Photoshop’s AI tool, alongside other materials for smooth chocolate effects.

![94c2d5a4a32141bc94b564fb69b8a743](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/94c2d5a4a32141bc94b564fb69b8a7439.%20Chocolate%20%26%20Coffee%20Material.png)![9669fef361864a7294f1e459e88af347](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/9669fef361864a7294f1e459e88af34710.%20Space%20Material.png)

The body and facial expressions of the Metahuman avatar were recorded frame by frame using ControlRig and saved as an animation.

![fb162395012040b9910135ea1c41e53f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/fb162395012040b9910135ea1c41e53f11.%20Controlrig.jpg)

The recorded animations of the faces and bodies were exported as FBX files and imported into CLO, where they were then applied to the clothing animations.

![5ffc242d1d9e4b6abd44df1e00b6cc4a](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/5ffc242d1d9e4b6abd44df1e00b6cc4a12.%20Animation%20Recording.jpg)

After recording the animation, the costume animation was imported into Unreal Engine using the LiveSync feature. The geometry cache of the costume was saved to align the avatar's position, simplifying the rendering of the animation with the costume matching the avatar's movement.

![4c0b608a57aa46cea60e4e7f205016e3](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/4c0b608a57aa46cea60e4e7f205016e313.%20Metahuman%20in%20Clothing.jpg)

# **What Challenges Did You Face, and How Did You Overcome Them?**

A major challenge was mesh distortion and crashes when importing CLO garments into Unreal Engine via LiveSync, often due to stretched or tangled patterns near the avatar’s arms. To fix this, I adjusted Metahuman’s control rig motion to keep body parts apart. For close-contact movements, I rendered the final animation using a costume without a collision pattern, preventing mesh errors.

![43a34636d8f24e58bdd61ef30ba32c21](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/43a34636d8f24e58bdd61ef30ba32c2114.%20Pose%20with%20Open%20Arms.png)![a74fde8e21734b52a735bf32bd2dc2c5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202503/d96edbf27767493daca714ae0bf750eb/images/a74fde8e21734b52a735bf32bd2dc2c515.%20Sleeveless%20Clothing.png)

* * *

# **How has CONNECT and CLO helped in your design process?**

**_The Chocolate & Coffee Project _**modified CONNECT's block patterns, streamlining early-stage design and enabling broader exploration. CLO, initially fashion-focused, proved versatile for modeling beyond fabric, sparking my interest in using it for solid structures like buildings. With intuitive tools like LiveSync, CLO empowers fashion designers to explore broader 3D modeling, unlocking endless creative possibilities.

* * *

Explore Changhun's portfolio and follow his creative journey on social media!

  * [_CONNECT Portfolio_](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/108694/collection/collections)

  *  _Instagram_[ _@fadyboo_](https://www.instagram.com/fadyboo/)
content_description: Explore how 3D artist Boo Changhun innovatively merges fashion design and cutting-edge 3D technology to create the immersive virtual project *Chocolate & Coffee*, blending rich textures and dynamic animation through CLO, Unreal Engine, and MetaHuman.
